properties.description: Simulates a datacenter/availability zone failure by shutting down VMSS instances and standalone VMs in the target zone. Zone failures account for ~25% of all cloud incidents — this scenario validates your application's cross-zone resilience.

parameters.name: physicalZone
parameters.description: Full physical availability-zone identifier to test, for example eastus-az1.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The duration of the zone down scenario.

actions.name: vmssZoneShutdown
actions.description: Shut down VMSS instances in target zone

actions.name: vmZoneShutdown
actions.description: Shut down VMs in target zone
